gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Goldman sets wide, bold letters with generous clearance, its round forms bending like open parentheses across the top of the page. Noto Sans Cuneiform follows with swollen, glassy lowercase and an open e.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Goldman brings bold, widely spaced letters with rounded shapes, giving the heading real command over everything beneath it. Noto Sans Deseret's open apertures make the sheer approachability the best thing here.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Goldman is bold and wide, with round forms like open parentheses. Noto Sans Devanagari reads in a modern, compact way, where capitals melt into the lowercase and the open lower curve of the g keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Commanding and bold, Goldman stretches its letters wide with generous clearance, while Noto Sans Duployan answers with oversized, open counters in the a and e. That roominess is what makes this pair work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan sets large lowercase forms with tight ascender clearance and terminals that never pinch shut, and Goldman above it stays bold and wide. Give the heading extra size so its wide round shapes can stand out.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Goldman is bold and commanding, with wide letters and a lowercase that stands tall against its capitals. Open apertures in Noto Sans Elymaic make the quiet, modern texture the pair's best feature.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Goldman delivers bold, wide display letters whose round forms curve like open parentheses. Noto Sans Ethiopic handles the steady work, with a tall, sturdy lowercase and c terminals that hang far from the bowl.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Wide, bold round forms like open parentheses mark Goldman out at once, with a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Noto Sans Georgian settles into a clean, modern run of open curves and short ascender stems, easy going over a full page.
